question: Can the three fixed P5O placement hypotheses be reduced to a deterministic bounded common-domain challenger that minimizes worst-case transmittance error without selecting or relabeling a physical domain?

algorithm.lower: pointwise minimum of the three fixed arm transmittances
algorithm.upper: pointwise maximum of the three fixed arm transmittances
algorithm.optimization: closed-form scalar Chebyshev center under absolute error

branch_rule.all_gates_pass: Retain the minimax midpoint plus explicit uncertainty as a synthetic film-inspired measured-MTF challenger and open a separately frozen photographic severe/style comparison.
branch_rule.bound_or_numerical_fail: Close the envelope and retain only the three explicit P5O hypotheses plus P5L reference evidence.
branch_rule.effect_empty: Close photographic advancement even if numerical safety passes.

forbidden: call the midpoint an identified exposure, density, transmittance, emulsion or process operator
drop the uncertainty half-range from evidence
fit arm weights, per-image routing or thresholds
compose with the replaced generic film spatial stages
use photographs or preference to change this algorithm or its gates
claim calibrated stock, roll, process, scanner or product response
claim_ceiling: Analytical bounded common-domain challenger for three unidentified measured-total placement hypotheses; not physical identification, calibrated stock response, photographic value or product promotion.
